name: Pomegranate
manufacturer_description: NS-088 Pomegranate is the lightest shade of the self-striking ruby family Northstar currently offers. This color is an easy-to-use color that will turn transparent once hot, but as it cools (depending on the thickness) will strike back to red. Because this color is so unsaturated, the final strike must take place to in a kiln. The strike is easily repeatable, and the final color is not affected by soaking in the kiln for long periods of time. Charges will be adjusted to match final product weight.
